snippet.title: Welcome to the Adventurer Inn! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Having just opened an inn, you set out to create a comfortable environment to bring in tired adventurers looking for respite after their questing. Earn money, upgrade your inn, and befriend a diverse cast of characters!

Welcome to the Adventurer Inn! on Kagura Games Store: https://www.kaguragames.com/product/welcome-to-the-adventurer-inn/
